scripts.//test: The glob is QUOTED so node expands it, not the shell. npm runs scripts under sh on Linux, where `**` is just `*` — unquoted, `src/**/*.test.ts` means `src/*/*.test.ts`. It matches nothing today (every test sits at the top of src/), so the literal falls through to node's globber and all tests run; add one test in a subdirectory and sh would match only that file and silently skip the rest.
